summary.text: Gale Mastrofrancesco, a Republican, represents the 80th Assembly District of Wolcott and part of Southington; she was re-elected in November 2024 to her fourth term and is an Assistant House Republican Leader.

paragraphs.text: She was raised in Waterbury and moved to Wolcott in 1996.
She was elected to the Wolcott Town Council in 2009 and served as its vice-chairwoman for seven years.
She has worked as a sales manager for AT&T Advertising and as Director of Community Relations at a senior living community in Meriden.
